description: Black to kill. White has the shape of an L with one extra eye-stone. Find the throw-in that destroys both potential eyes, then follow up to capture.

S19.comment: Vital point. The throw-in attacks both potential eyes (L11 and J11) at once.

P19.comment: Remove white's last outside liberty. White is forced to capture, but the resulting shape has only one eye.

S19.comment: Throw in again. White has only one eye and no outside liberties - the whole group is captured.

T19.comment: Wrong direction. White captures with K11 and the resulting shape has clean eyes at L11 and J11.

R19.comment: Wrong direction. White captures with K11 and the resulting shape has clean eyes at L11 and J11.

P19.comment: Outside before inside fails - white plays the vital point K11 and lives with two clean eyes.
